issue.title: Rotate exposed credentials and purge agents-sidecar history
issue.description: Resolve the historical exposure tracked by sase-1ou.5 with private triage, owner-confirmed credential rotation, a rehearsed and explicitly approved purge, and evidence that all three hosts resume publication without restoring old history.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/agents_history_remediation.md requests this work

issue.title: Classify findings and prepare the rotation checklist
issue.description: private-triage: account for every original finding and reachable historical variant without exposing values, prepare private purge inputs and a human rotation checklist, and preserve value-free evidence across credential rotation.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agents_history_remediation.md defines phase private-triage as one work unit

issue.title: Prepare and test the three-host maintenance procedure
issue.description: fleet-protocol: inventory every agents-sidecar writer and clone on athena, apollo and mac, implement a private command bundle for quiescence and clone recovery, and verify it on disposable fixtures without production mutations.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agents_history_remediation.md defines phase fleet-protocol as one work unit

issue.title: Rehearse the purge and assemble the execution package
issue.description: purge-rehearsal: bind the private removal manifest to frozen refs, rehearse the history transformation and fleet recovery on isolated copies, and prepare exact commands, count comparisons and stop conditions for human review.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agents_history_remediation.md defines phase purge-rehearsal as one work unit

issue.title: Gate execution and verify the published result
issue.description: review-execute: obtain rotation confirmation and explicit approval of the concrete purge, execute through a durable gate turn, verify rewritten remote refs and every host, and record either completion or the owner's deferral.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agents_history_remediation.md defines phase review-execute as one work unit

No repo files changed; no follow-up beads created per plan.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Refresh the approved manifest before another rehearsal — the remote tip is 9 commits and 362 paths beyond its pinned snapshot, and the history scan found 15 unmanifested hits; keep filtering disabled until owners classify the findings and approve a refreshed manifest.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Restore the private phase .1.2 fleet fixture bundle and evidence to shared attachment storage — the local-only files could not be fetched here, so the lease and recovery fixtures were not independently rerun.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Make branch protection an explicit gate preflight — the read-only probe found no classic main protection or repository ruleset; verify organization rulesets and require the reviewed expected-old lease before any publication.

Verified the isolated rehearsal fails closed before transformation: it found 15 history hits outside the approved manifest, which is pinned 9 commits and 362 paths behind the refreshed remote. Attached the private diagnostic packet and unsent support draft, recorded follow-ups for manifest reconciliation, fixture recovery, and gate preflight, and confirmed no production history, services, or settings changed. This is a diagnostic closeout; the package is not authorization-ready until those follow-ups are resolved.

Validated predecessor package: not authorization-ready (15 unmanifested history hits, manifest 9 commits/362 paths behind, git-filter-repo unpinned, 27 unresolved attestations, no production bundle). Read-only refresh: origin/main bf86574b39021946b5a65b20cc53afc4edcc8fe8; athena/apollo/mac reachable; secret scanning and push protection enabled; classic main protection absent. Creating a durable owner gate (auto:false) whose approve command is fail-closed preflight only. No production mutation this turn.

Private timeout refresh: identities, protection, hosts, and no-rewrite verdicts only.

@attachment:timeout-refresh.json

Owner gate custom-ffb7ee2a-0d78-4fc4-a7fc-a771fa3c7d76 timed out after 24h with no answer. Timeout is a technical outcome, not an owner deferral. No option command ran. No rewrite, force-push, clone reset, or publisher stop. Advertised sase--agents main advanced 79 ordinary commits (prior tip remains an ancestor). Secret scanning and push protection remain enabled; classic main protection remains absent. athena and apollo reachable; mac unreachable this turn; athena sase.service still running. Purge remains pending and not authorization-ready (15 unmanifested hits, manifest 88 commits/1383 paths stale, unpinned git-filter-repo, no production bundle). Recreating the same auto:false owner-decision gate; approve remains fail-closed preflight only.

Private reject refresh: identities, protection, hosts, and no-rewrite verdicts only.

@attachment:reject-refresh.json

Private reject refresh: identities, protection, hosts, and no-rewrite verdicts only.

@attachment:reject-refresh.json

Owner answered gate custom-b52a9f2c-76c5-4d6c-af5b-a700faf05d10 via TUI with Decline the purge (reject). This is an explicit owner reject, not a technical failure. The reject command is a no-op recorder. Independent advertised-ref check: origin/main a7a40e22624ad1dcc3578fba04c81b199487ed6f is a 10-commit fast-forward from the timeout snapshot ad6133b6a6a999b187e0d044c9e7618de0e4b82f; audited tip 5066d26a4b234769f48be023e92038d9d9727c0f remains an ancestor; commits_now_to_audit=0. No rewrite, force-push, clone reset, or publisher stop. Secret scanning and push protection remain enabled; classic main protection remains absent. athena, apollo, and mac reachable; athena sase.service active. Purge was not executed and remains pending. sase-1ot remains open.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: owner rejected the sase--agents historical purge; sase-1ot remains the owning task; remaining remediation is explicit owner rotation plus a future reviewed purge if the owner later requests one.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: custom-gate TUI review modal for the primary AND branch hid sibling OR branches (rotation_only/defer/reject); owner note plus screenshot ~/tmp/screenshots/20261028_142318.png — keep alternative branches visible while the primary form is open.

Owner rejected gate custom-b52a9f2c-76c5-4d6c-af5b-a700faf05d10 (Decline the purge). Independent check: advertised sase--agents main a7a40e22624ad1dcc3578fba04c81b199487ed6f is a fast-forward of prior snapshots; audited tip 5066d26a remains an ancestor; reject command was a no-op; no rewrite, force-push, clone reset, or publisher stop. Purge was not executed. sase-1ot left open.

LAND VERIFIED on 2026-10-28; completion is the approved OWNER-DECLINE branch, not a successful purge. Read the epic, every note of all four children, both linked plans, private audit/history-driver source, fleet CLI/writer/preflight/recovery fixtures, rehearsal/readiness diagnostics, and actual durable gate result/command. All descendants are closed. No new DECISIONS were present; inherited dormant_flakes=close is unrelated. Credential values were not consumed, no protection bypass or production mutation was performed, and the timeout was never treated as an owner answer.

Gate custom-b52a9f2c-76c5-4d6c-af5b-a700faf05d10 was explicitly answered reject via TUI. Stored result: owner_reject, production_changed=false, rewrite_attempted=false, purge_pending=true. The reject resource only consumes stdin and emits JSON. Fresh advertised main db5a6c9515104553fb95e5c414a5ca8e54e50f20 is 2 ordinary commits after a7a40e22624ad1dcc3578fba04c81b199487ed6f; original audit tip 5066d26a remains an ancestor. Therefore the purge, rotations, transformed-history audit, and production resume proof are NOT complete. The approved child landing and outer agents-secret-purge phase explicitly accept owner decline with sase-1ot left open. Recorded the actual answer and remaining prerequisites on sase-1ot and carried PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP to sase-1ou.5.

Verification: audit-driver synthetic clean/hit/binary/oversize selftest PASS; fleet bundle SHA256 70cd3ea90a7f3f9109b2a2ace9db79400a3118048fe4422e95270e742ff13c28 matches its note and all 20 fixture tests PASS. Phase .3 is correctly recognized as diagnostic-only: 15 extra history hits, stale manifest, no pinned filtering tool or production bundle. Its technical gaps remain explicit under the owner's declined remediation, not claimed resolved.

FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (every proposal):
1. .2 note 2, Mac version/protection skew: retained as a mandatory refresh/update-or-isolation preflight on existing sase-1ot. Declined a separate blanket deployment task because the observation is a stale execution prerequisite, not evidence authorizing a fleet update.
2. .3 note 2, stale manifest and 15 unmanifested hits: retained on sase-1ot, including owner classification and a new frozen-ref rehearsal if remediation is renewed. Declined duplicate task and automatic scope widening.
3. .3 note 3, private fixture availability: local bytes verified and tests rerun; shared upload still exits 1. Raw marker project key sase-org/sase versus canonical gh_sase-org__sase independently reproduces existing sase-1j7; added +1 there. Not declared fixed. Related visibility task sase-1db is distinct.
4. .3 note 4, branch protection preflight: retained on sase-1ot; check organization/repository rulesets and exact expected-old leases before any renewed operation. Declined independent settings-change task because no execution/settings authorization exists.
5. .4 note 7, owner rejection: corroborated existing sase-1ot with durable response and fresh ancestry evidence; leave READY. No duplicate remediation task.
6. .4 note 8, hidden sibling OR branches: independently reproduced with a synthetic 120x40 styled pilot (active GateInputPanel has Submit/Cancel only, zero alternatives; 3 remain underneath). Created medium ready bug sase-1pb, evidence file:explicit:a53b7375f68715da9f823fc1 and private owner screenshot. Source traces to pre-epic sase-q3.3; no causal active epic or duplicate found.

INTEGRATION: no source commit in sase or agents/plans history mentions this epic; deliverables are private attachments and plan commits 92fc99bbe/6bed1116a. Reviewed changes since recorded planning base 13df005a through d1a576ab4e, then fetched/reviewed base dee47ef979. Agents publication/scanner paths are unchanged. New verified snapshot, nested preservation, failed-close and reset/replay paths (42512dc116, 55ebb614f2, 2bb3e813d3, dcb7d2a6e7, c175d66667, d12d712e79 and module splits) need no runtime integration for an unexecuted purge; their backup/replay and published-base dependencies are now explicitly included in sase-1ot's future inventory/recovery requirements. No product file changes; no check-full run. epic-symbols reports no entries. Closing normally without force.

POST-CLOSE VERIFICATION: just symvision ran to completion after refreshing only the local venv and exited 1 solely on the existing _RecoveryAssessment private-import violation in src/sase/finalizers/_failed_close_recovery_assess.py. Independently corroborated ready CI task sase-1p3; no epic exemptions remain for this epic or parent phase. Plan plan:202610/agents_history_remediation.md frontmatter is now status: done, preserving bead_id and parent_bead; diff --check passes and its only diff is that one status line. Parent sase-1ou.5 closed normally via delegated landing and explicit close confirmed it; no --force used. Outer sase-1ou and remediation task sase-1ot remain open. No primary source files changed, so just check was not required; check-full was not run.
